name: Oreslang injected state containers candidate
rules: The backing annotation constructs and owns storage; @Inject resolves an already provided container.
State container handles are immutable capabilities; nested mutable data is accessible only through scoped read/write borrowing.
Instance state is not implicitly shared; #shared must be explicit and scheduler-authorized.
No mutable alias escapes callbacks; no await/select/cooperate inside protected access.
Unknown annotations must reject rather than be ignored. A positive case must execute before negative cases can prove semantic parity.
Unverified/unsupported backend diagnostics never count as successful execution.

evidenceRequirements.source: identical Oreslang UTF-8 bytes and fixture digest across all backends
evidenceRequirements.compiler: exact commit SHA and real compiler invocation; no replacements or surrogate parsers
evidenceRequirements.tests: nonzero build, compile and guest execution steps in approved runner
evidenceRequirements.positive: successful compile plus exact stdout/exit code; unsupported source is NOT a pass
evidenceRequirements.negative: compiler-owned reason-specific denial with no emitted IR, native object or executable
evidenceRequirements.security: complete physical retirement and state capability provenance require separate runtime proof
evidenceRequirements.admission: do not promote registry without real run evidence for every required backend
